dataList.content:
M-Manager Esquire, halt! Behold this poor fellow, he lives still!
请、请止步！经理老爷！看看那人！那人还活着！
dataList.place:
WARP Train Economy Class Cabin
WARP列车 经济舱 车厢

dataList.content:
Don Quixote, her round eyes wide open, began sprinting somewhere.
睁大双眼的堂吉诃德迅速跑过去。

dataList.title:
W Corp.
W公司
dataList.content:
N-no, stay away from me, you monsters...!
什、什么……别过来！该死的……！

H-hey, man. We're not those... monsters. You alright?
喂、喂。我们……不是那些怪物。你没事吧？

dataList.title:
W Corp.
W公司
dataList.content:
That arm... Y-you're starting to mutate too, aren't you...? You must be turning into some bug-like monste— Agh.
你也开始转变了吗……？变成虫肢怪物……呃。

What? No, this is...
啊？不是，这是……

Gregor stumbled for words, scoffed, then cast his gaze toward the floor in disbelief.
格里高尔想再回答什么，但又很快无可奈何地苦笑着低下了头。

Yeah, well... no surprise there, I guess. I suppose there's no way to tell right away whether this arm's a monster, a prosthetic, or whatnot.
好吧，算了……你会误会也很正常。这只手臂，一眼看上去确实分不出是义体还是怪物吧。

It is possible that you are mistaken due to his bio-prosthetic being of an older, outdated make that is now rarely seen in the City.
即使同为生物型义手，像这般无骨骼的旧式型号最近在都市也十分罕见，因此会产生混淆也是正常的。

dataList.title:
W Corp.
W公司
dataList.content:
Ah, a prosthetic...
啊……是义体……

dataList.title:
W Corp.
W公司
dataList.content:
That's a relief. I thought those crazy bastards were trying to break in again. As you can see, my legs are messed up... I had no choice but to hide in here...
太好了，我还以为那些疯子又打过来了……正如你们所见，我的腿现在变成这副样子……只能藏在这里……

So what are the W Corp. employees doing aboard this train?
那么W公司的员工为什么会乘坐这辆列车？

<Huh, you're right... From what we found out about the WARP trains through the Identities, I can't imagine why any of them would ever willingly board this train...>
<确实……根据人格们的说法，自从知道WARP列车真实情况的那一瞬间就应该连看都不想看了吧……>

dataList.title:
W Corp.
W公司
dataList.content:
You're the contract Fixers, right...? We were ordered to assist you with your contract.
各位是接受了外部委托前来的收尾人吗……？我们得到了要帮助各位解决事件的命令。

dataList.title:
W Corp.
W公司
dataList.content:
... I said "we," but... I'm the only one left. Every single one of my colleagues suddenly began losing their minds in that car over there, and...
虽说是我们……现在也只剩我一个了……同事们在之前的车厢一个接一个失去理智……最后……

This cannot be... Faust! Is there truly no way to cure the Bloodbags?
怎么会……浮士德小姐！难道没有将血袋复原的方法吗？

My apologies. The access to that information is prohibited at this moment as well.
十分抱歉。那些信息现在无法阅览。

Though her voice and expression were both as serene as always, there was something gloomy about the way she said it.
虽然她的语气十分平淡，但总有种难以抹去的忧郁感。

... I may have been too reliant on Faust. In too many places.
……或许是太依赖浮士德了。

Faust muttered in a barely audible volume.
浮士德隐隐约约嘟哝了一句。

... I don't know what I can do to help the Sinners in a situation like this, either.
……我也不知道此刻能怎样帮助罪人。

I'd also grown too used to Faust's omniscience because I could always trust it to be there for me. I was starting to realize that I don't have the means to dig myself out of a hole like this...
或许是因为过于习惯了才没能注意到，我也相当依赖于浮士德的信息。对于如何解决这样的情况，我个人束手无策……

... No, maybe I was too reliant on the Sinners as a whole.
不对，应该说我在依靠所有罪人们。

If... when the time comes for them to depend on me, when they can no longer stand on their own, can I really manage them? Lead them to the right choices?
如果罪人们各自失去了他们的能力，我还能好好管理他们吗？还能带领他们做出正确的选择吗？

Doubt, colored with fear, begins to rise like an ominous plume of smoke.
瞬间，这一疑问裹挟着恐惧涌上心头。

dataList.title:
W Corp.
W公司
dataList.content:
Well... What can I do, right? Agh...
算了……没事。咳。

The agent struggled to some corner of the room with his wounded leg, and pulled on a lever...
员工拖着受伤的腿痛苦地向某处前进，随后拉开了某个小小的拉杆……

They made good use of this space.
在这种空间里居然能完美地隐藏这样的东西。

... and the wall behind what had initially appeared to be a folding chair for employees spun open.
看上去十分普通的乘务员用椅附近的墙壁打开了。

Ooh, what in the name of Wings is this?! Perchance, hast thou hidden here a weapon most powerful, a weapon most afeared by the Bloodfiends...?!
这是？！难道这之中隐藏了能够打倒血魔的秘密武器……！

That holds some resemblance to a capsule we saw on the first class car, but why would that thing be here...?
和在头等舱看到的胶囊舱相似，但为什么会在这里……？

The Cleanup Agent slumped into the pod that appeared in the wall.
清扫人员瘫坐进打开的墙壁中类似冬眠舱一样的地方。

dataList.title:
W Corp.
W公司
dataList.content:
Phew... finally.
哎……稍微好点了。

Hm? What is it that thou seekest to do?
嗯？汝这是做什么？

dataList.title:
W Corp.
W公司
dataList.content:
W Corp. prepared a small hibernation pod for employees in case of these emergencies.
W公司为了应付这种情况，准备了员工用的小型冬眠舱啊。

Verily! Then... huh?
原来如此！那么……嗯？

dataList.title:
W Corp.
W公司
dataList.content:
Good luck... with the rest of the mission...
祝你们好运……剩下的就拜托你们了……

With that, he settled into the capsule, and shut the hatch behind him.
他只留下这一句话，就将胶囊舱从内部啪一下关上了。

When the door covering the pod closed, only the folding chair and a wall covered with viscera remained.
最后，装着那个冬眠舱的门也彻底关闭……原本的空间又一次恢复原状，变回了简单的椅子和血肉模糊的墙壁。

<He's gone...>
<他走了……>

There he goes...
他走了呢……

He has departed the scene.
他已经走了。

We blankly stared at the wall the Agent disappeared into.
我们茫然地看向W公司员工离开的地方。

Well, then. I guess we gotta...
这种时候也只能……

<... Let's move on to the next car.>
<……往下一节车厢前进吧。>

... keep on keeping on.
继续前进吧。
